partial_weeks.reason: Initial boundary week: Raw data starts on 2014-01-03 (Friday), covering only 3/7 days.

partial_week_recommendation: Exclude initial partial week 2013-12-30 from model training/validation splits. Rationale: It represents only 3 calendar days (Friday Jan 3 to Sunday Jan 5, 2014) rather than a full 7-day business week, artificially distorting lag features (e.g. lag-1 demand) and rolling baseline calculations.
